title: the gnomish deity prose
audit_comment: THE GNOMISH DEITY PROSE - part 4 of the Appendix S description-paragraph close. The archive.org full-text OCR of pp. 116-118 reads the four gnomish blocks scan-clean: the Baervan Whisperleaf spear and the raccoon Chiktikka, the Urdlen blur and the soul-eating evil, the Segojan rock speech and the quartz rod, and the Flandal fire apron and the hammer Rhondang. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph facts ride rules/uadeityprose4.h.

banner.provenance: Part 4 of the five-part close (R786 the dwarves, R787 the elves, R788 the halflings). The four gnomish blocks (pp. 116-118) read scan-clean in the archive.org full-text OCR: every pin below is the printed text. The stat-block numerics stay R406/R783; the paragraph-level facts pin here - the Whisperleaf spear craft and the Chiktikka partnership, the Urdlen soul debt and the blood appeasement, the Segojan golem rod and the glowing gem symbols, and the Rhondang fireballs and the fire elemental retinue. Part 5 remains: the orcs.

consts.name: udp4ProseRound
consts.comment: The prose round: part 4, the gnomish paragraphs

consts.name: udp4StatblockFeederRound
consts.comment: The feeder round: the R406 stat blocks these paragraphs hang under

consts.name: udp4GnomishDeityCount
consts.comment: The gnomish census: four blocks described (Baervan, Urdlen, Segojan, Flandal)

consts.name: udp4PantheonCountMin
consts.comment: By most counts there are only six or seven gnomish deities: the minimum six

consts.name: udp4PantheonCountMax
consts.comment: and the maximum seven, though there may be more in other universes

consts.name: udp4BaeSpearBonus
consts.comment: He carries a spear +3 made from the ancient oak Whisperleaf

consts.name: udp4BaeSpearRemakeDays
consts.comment: If the spear is destroyed he may make another from Whisperleaf wood in a single day

consts.name: udp4BaeWhisperleafRegenHours
consts.comment: Whisperleaf regenerates all wood loss within an hour

consts.name: udp4BaeTreeAnimTurnsMin
consts.comment: His spear animates an ordinary tree for 5-20 turns: the minimum 5

consts.name: udp4BaeTreeAnimTurnsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 20

consts.name: udp4BaeTreeTreantHitDice
consts.comment: The animated tree is a treant of 12 hit dice

consts.name: udp4BaeTreesPerRound
consts.comment: He may animate one tree per round, as often as he likes

consts.name: udp4BaeChikAc
consts.comment: His raccoon partner Chiktikka Fastpaws is AC 3

consts.name: udp4BaeChikMoveInches
consts.comment: Chiktikka moves at 15 inches

consts.name: udp4BaeChikHp
consts.comment: and has 70 hit points

consts.name: udp4BaeChikThiefLevel
consts.comment: Chiktikka has all the powers of a 12th-level thief

consts.name: udp4BaeChikDex
consts.comment: with an 18 dexterity

consts.name: udp4BaeChikClawDamageMin
consts.comment: Chiktikka does 2-8 points of claw damage: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp4BaeChikClawDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 8

consts.name: udp4BaeChikBiteDamageMin
consts.comment: Chiktikka bites for 2-12 points of damage: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp4BaeChikBiteDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 12

consts.name: udp4BaeGiftMeetChancePct
consts.comment: About a 1 percent chance that a worshiper who performed a great deed meets him and receives a minor magical item

consts.name: udp4UrdBlurClericChancePct
consts.comment: His clerics have a 5 percent chance of calling upon Urdlen in danger for his protective blur

consts.name: udp4SegArmorBonus
consts.comment: His grass-and-roots armor acts as +4 leather

consts.name: udp4SegRodBonus
consts.comment: His crystalline quartz rod is +4 to hit

consts.name: udp4SegRodDamageMin
consts.comment: The rod does 3-30 points of damage per hit: the minimum 3

consts.name: udp4SegRodDamageMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 30

consts.name: udp4SegGolemPerDay
consts.comment: The rod creates a stone golem once a day

consts.name: udp4SegElementalsPerDay
consts.comment: Segojan may call up earth elementals once a day

consts.name: udp4SegElementalsMin
consts.comment: The summons brings 2-8 earth elementals: the minimum 2

consts.name: udp4SegElementalsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 8

consts.name: udp4SegElementalHitDice
consts.comment: each with 16 hit dice

consts.name: udp4FlaHammerBonus
consts.comment: His axe-backed hammer Rhondang is +5 to hit

consts.name: udp4FlaFireballDice
consts.comment: Rhondang shoots a six-dice fireball

consts.name: udp4FlaFireballPerRound
consts.comment: as frequently as once per round

consts.name: udp4FlaFireballPerDay
consts.comment: up to a total of ten times per day

consts.name: udp4FlaElementalChancePct
consts.comment: A 65 percent chance he has fire elementals with him when encountered

consts.name: udp4FlaElementalsMin
consts.comment: He is likely to have 1-4 fire elementals: the minimum 1

consts.name: udp4FlaElementalsMax
consts.comment: and the maximum 4

consts.name: udp4FlaElementalHitDice
consts.comment: each with 16 hit dice

bools.name: udp4PanFewestMembers
bools.comment: The gnomish pantheon is the demi-human pantheon with the fewest members

bools.name: udp4PanGarlRulesAll
bools.comment: All gnomish gods except Urdlen the Crawler are ruled by Garl Glittergold

bools.name: udp4PanGoldenHills
bools.comment: All but Urdlen live on the Twin Paradises in the Golden Hills, where the souls of faithful gnomes go at death

bools.name: udp4PanUrdlenInAbyss
bools.comment: Urdlen lives in the Abyss

bools.name: udp4PanAllMasculine
bools.comment: All the known gnomish deities are masculine, worshiped by male and female gnomes with equal reverence

bools.name: udp4PanCleverSensible
bools.comment: They lack the he-man image and are clever, sensible, and helpful

bools.name: udp4PanUrdlenSexless
bools.comment: Urdlen is sexless though still referred to as a he, and shares none of these good qualities

bools.name: udp4PanCompanionsCommon
bools.comment: Gnomish gods nearly always have at least one companion - a weapon, animal, or other deity

bools.name: udp4PanGarlHasArumdina
bools.comment: Garl has Arumdina, his intelligent battle axe

bools.name: udp4PanSegojanGolemFriend
bools.comment: Segojan is sometimes accompanied by an intelligent stone golem

bools.name: udp4PanUrdlenFriendless
bools.comment: Urdlen, an exception again, has no friends

bools.name: udp4PanPranksAgainstEnemies
bools.comment: Pranks and practical jokes are a major response of gnomish gods to their enemies

bools.name: udp4PanLooseDwarvenContact
bools.comment: They usually only associate with other gnomish deities, though they keep loose contact with a few dwarven gods

bools.name: udp4PanMostActive
bools.comment: The gnomish pantheon is one of the most active and most involved with its worshipers

bools.name: udp4BaeRivalOfGarl
bools.comment: He is Garl Glittergold closest rival in the field of good-natured mischief, slightly better at thieving practice

bools.name: udp4BaeWoodBrownClothes
bools.comment: He dresses in clothes of wood-brown hues

bools.name: udp4BaeOnlyHeApproachesTree
bools.comment: Only Baervan may safely approach Whisperleaf; the tree attacks all others as a treant of maximum size and hit points

bools.name: udp4BaeTreeObeysOnlyHim
bools.comment: The animated tree/treant obeys all of Baervan orders and no one elses

bools.name: udp4BaeChikHasty
bools.comment: Chiktikka is highly intelligent but prone to act before he thinks

bools.name: udp4BaeChikBorrower
bools.comment: Many stories are told of the trouble Chiktikka starts by borrowing something valuable

bools.name: udp4BaeNutBrownSkin
bools.comment: Baervan is distinguished by his nut-brown skin and pale gray hair

bools.name: udp4BaeKeepsToHimself
bools.comment: He tends to keep to himself except for Chiktikka company, and sometimes roams the forests of the Prime Material Plane

bools.name: udp4BaeGiftOncePerLifetime
bools.comment: Such a worshiper will meet Baervan only once in his or her lifetime

bools.name: udp4BaeHardToDislike
bools.comment: Though he sometimes plays jokes on other creatures, it is hard not to like him

bools.name: udp4BaeFollowersOutdoorsmen
bools.comment: Gnomish fighters, fighter/thieves, and thieves of a non-evil nature follow him, preferring the outdoors to a city

bools.name: udp4UrdEvilImpulse
bools.comment: Urdlen is the epitome of the evil impulse that rules some gnomes and is feared by the rest

bools.name: udp4UrdFurlessWhiteMole
bools.comment: He appears as a huge, dead-white, furless mole with claws of steel

bools.name: udp4UrdLustsForMetals
bools.comment: He lusts for precious metals, jewels, and the blood of any human, humanoid, or demi-human

bools.name: udp4UrdUnpredictable
bools.comment: No one can predict where he will strike next, or what his plans are to further evil among gnomekind

bools.name: udp4UrdPermanentBlur
bools.comment: His form is distorted by a permanent blur spell which cannot be dispelled while he lives

bools.name: udp4UrdEatsSlainClericSoul
bools.comment: If a protected cleric is slain anyway while the blur is in effect, Urdlen will eat the gnome soul when it reaches the Abyss

bools.name: udp4UrdAppeasedByBlood
bools.comment: His clerics appease him by pouring the blood of a creature they have killed into the ground and burying it

bools.name: udp4UrdSacrificeByRuining
bools.comment: Jewels and valuable metal goods are sacrificed by ruining them - breaking, tarnishing, melting - and then burying them

bools.name: udp4UrdAtWarWithPantheon
bools.comment: Clerics of this deity are continually at war with the rest of the gnomish deities and their clerics and followers

bools.name: udp4UrdFollowersUnderground
bools.comment: Gnomish assassins and evil thieves and fighters worship him, often living underground after the manner of his chaotic tunnel home

bools.name: udp4SegSpeaksToRock
bools.comment: He is a friend to all living animals above and below the earth, and one who speaks to the very rock itself

bools.name: udp4SegGraySkinned
bools.comment: He is known to his worshipers as a gray-skinned gnome

bools.name: udp4SegGolemAverageIntelligence
bools.comment: The rod-created stone golem is of average intelligence and obeys Segojan commands alone

bools.name: udp4SegGolemNeedsRockMass
bools.comment: The rod must be pressed against a mass of rock of sufficient size to form the golem

bools.name: udp4SegLesserGodOfMagic
bools.comment: He is also seen in a lesser way as the gnomish god of magic

bools.name: udp4SegIllusionistFollowers
bools.comment: Many of his followers are illusionists who strive to improve their art for the betterment of gnomekind

bools.name: udp4SegMinersAndJewelers
bools.comment: Gnomish miners and jewelers also revere this deity

bools.name: udp4SegGlowingGemSymbols
bools.comment: His clerics frequently cast light or continual light on large well-cut gems for use as holy symbols, causing them to glow from within

bools.name: udp4FlaApronOnlyArmor
bools.comment: He wears only a leather apron for armor, enchanted to reduce by half all damage from heat and fire

bools.name: udp4FlaMithrilSkin
bools.comment: His skin is the color of mithril steel, his eyes flaming coals, and his hair and beard a brilliant blue-silver

bools.name: udp4FlaStrongestGnomishGod
bools.comment: He is one of the strongest of gnomish deities, perhaps the most so

bools.name: udp4FlaForgedArumdina
bools.comment: It was Flandal who helped forge and enchant Arumdina, Garl Glittergold battle axe

bools.name: udp4FlaTravelsSeekingOres
bools.comment: He is often found traveling with one or two other gnomish deities in search of new ores and veins of metal

bools.name: udp4FlaRhondangSpeaksFire
bools.comment: Rhondang converses naturally with all beings who use fire or dwell in fiery locations - red dragons, chimerae, fire elementals

bools.name: udp4FlaTalksBeforeAttacking
bools.comment: This does not make him friendly toward those beings, though he will be prone to talk first before attacking

bools.name: udp4FlaRhondangDoubleVsCold
bools.comment: Rhondang does double damage to cold-using or cold-dwelling creatures

bools.name: udp4FlaElementalsObedient
bools.comment: His fire elementals are quite friendly toward him and obey him in all respects, because he needs their services to help forge items

bools.name: udp4FlaWorkshopOnTwinParadises
bools.comment: When not traveling he is found in his workshop on the Twin Paradises, planning or making a new magical weapon

bools.name: udp4FlaSmithsFollowHim
bools.comment: He is a popular god among the gnomish smiths; a large number of fighter/clerics follow his worship in some areas

bools.name: udp4FlaFlamingHammerSpell
bools.comment: Some of his clerics have developed or been granted a new spell that makes their war hammers burst into flame like a flame tongue long sword
